body_markdown:
CHARLOTTE, N.C.


, Oct. 16, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Truist Financial Corporation (NYSE: TFC) reported its third quarter 2026 results today. Investors can access the live third quarter 2026 earnings call at 8 a.m. ET today by webcast or dial-in as follows:


- **Webcast:**[app.webinar.net/BAM6O91OpkL](https://app.webinar.net/BAM6O91OpkL)


- **Dial-in:** 1-877-883-0383, passcode 2090022


The earnings release, investor presentation, including an appendix reconciling non-GAAP disclosures, and Truist's Third Quarter 2026 Quarterly Performance Summary, which contains detailed financial schedules, are available at Truist's Investor Relations website at[https://ir.truist.com/earnings](https://ir.truist.com/earnings) . A replay of the call will be available on the website for 30 days.


**About Truist**


Truist Financial Corporation (NYSE: TFC) is a purpose-driven financial services company committed to inspiring and building better lives and communities. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Truist has leading market share in many of the high-growth markets in the U.S. and offers a wide range of products and services through wholesale and consumer businesses, including consumer and small business banking, commercial and corporate banking, investment banking and capital markets, wealth management, payments, and specialized lending businesses. Truist is a top-10 commercial bank with total assets of $554 billion as of Sept. 30, 2026. Truist Bank, Member FDIC. Equal Housing Lender. Learn more at[Truist.com](https://www.truist.com/) .
